newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Wednesday's interbank session softer on the U.S. dollar and the rand but was quoted firmer against European currencies, tracking overseas market trends, dealers said.
"The dollar went down to about 11.3150/3250 (against the U.S. dollar) on the back of import pressure before the Reserve Bank came and stabilised it at 11.3100/3200, where it closed," one dealer said.

This compared with Tuesday's 11.2950/3050. The local unit also eased to 2.5440/5480 from 2.5300/5500 against the South African rand but strengthened against sterling to 18.4050/4270 from 18.4900/5100. It was quoted at 6.5970/6050 versus the mark, up from 6.6100/6300.
